== Title ==
<span lang="ja">撤退せよ！</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">相手の合計戦闘力が自分の側の２倍を越えている屋外の位置で相手が戦闘を宣言した直後に使用する。１フォース消費して、戦闘をキャンセルし、そこにいる自分のキャラクターを全員、敵が人員を持っていない隣接位置に移動させる。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">「Kワンゼロへ、全兵員は任務を放棄せよ」</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — Fall Back!.

'''Lore''' — “K-one zero…all troops disengage.”

'''Game text''' — If the opponent just initiated a battle at an outdoor location with more than double your total power, use 1 Force to cancel it. Move all your characters there to an adjacent location with no enemy presence.

The Japanese face uses 屋外の位置 (outdoor location) and 隣接位置 where the English face says exterior site and adjacent site. 人員 is used for the presence test.<ref>[[:File:Hoth-L-fallback-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[Fall Back!]].</ref>
